title: Introduction to EarthFlux
text: Surface state. Satellite products (MODIS first) converted sensor-independent physical variables: land surface temperature (K), broadband albedo, NDVI, leaf area index surface emissivity. Meteorological forcing. Weather station data quality controlled , optionally, regionalised spatial surfaces, example geographically weighted regression (GWR). Surface energy balance (METRIC). Net radiation (Rn), soil heat flux (G), anchor pixel calibration, aerodynamic resistance (rah), near-surface temperature difference (dT) sensible heat flux (H) computed separate functions. Latent heat flux residual LE = Rn - G - H. Evapotranspiration. LE converted instantaneous ET, reference ET fraction (ETrF) finally daily ETa using reference evapotranspiration. Diagnostics. step reports quality flags instead silently modifying anomalous values.

title: Atmospheric pressure from elevation — ef_air_pressure
text: pressure $$P = 101.3 \left(\frac{293 - 0.0065 z}{293}\right)^{5.26}$$ \(z\) elevation [m] \(P\) kPa (FAO-56, chapter 3, Eq. 7). Assumptions (FAO-56, chapter 3 annex 3): standard atmosphere reference temperature 293 K sea level constant lapse rate 0.0065 K m-1; exponent 5.26 approximates \(g / (\alpha_1 R)\) g = 9.807 m s-2, R = 287 J kg-1 K-1 \(\alpha_1\) = 0.0065 K m-1. result mean pressure site: synoptic pressure variations represented. FAO-56 states effect pressure evapotranspiration small mean value location sufficient. Missing values (NA, NaN) propagate output without errors warnings. elevation must numeric (double integer) non-empty. Infinite values elevations 45 076.92 m raise error class earthflux_domain_error (also earthflux_input_error). plausible elevation range study area checked (threshold documented reference). Verification status: VERIFICADA (identical FAO-56, chapter 3, Eq. 7). attribution ASCE-EWRI (2005) verified.

text: Method "etrf" computes $$ETa_{24} = ETrF \cdot ETr_{24}$$ \(ETrF\) etrf \(ETr_{24}\) etr_24, cumulative reference evapotranspiration image day. Assumption: fraction \(ETrF\) overpass time constant whole day, .e. actual evapotranspiration changes proportion reference evapotranspiration. assumption weakened diurnal variation ratio (stomatal closure, drying soil surface irrigation, increasing water stress), overpass time, clouds overpass, night hours included \(ETr_{24}\), terrain (slope correction applied) mixed pixels 1 km. common multiplicative bias instantaneous daily reference evapotranspiration cancels: result depends ratio \(ETr_{24} / ETr_{inst}\). Reference crop: etrf etr_24 must refer reference crop (one cold anchor pixel). reference change computation: makes choice explicit. consistency check steps made orchestration layer. Slope correction: correction daily energy availability sloping terrain used METRIC implementations applied; form source pending verification. Negative values etrf give negative daily evapotranspiration, returned unchanged without warning (never set zero). etr_24 = 0 result zero whatever sign etrf. diagnostic flag EF_ET_NEGATIVE assembled orchestration layer layer. title: Instantaneous evapotranspiration from the latent heat flux — ef_et_inst
text: depth water equals energy per unit area divided \(\lambda \rho_w\) (FAO-56, chapter 3, box 8). flux \(LE\) W m-2 = J s-1 m-2, energy accumulated rate one hour \(3600 LE\), $$ET_{inst} = \frac{1000 \cdot 3600 \cdot LE}{\lambda \rho_w}$$ 1000 mm m-1, 3600 s h-1, \(\lambda\) lambda [J kg-1] \(\rho_w\) = 1000 kg m-3 density water (FAO-56, chapter 3, box 8; internal constant, argument). \(\rho_w\) = 1000 kg m-3 numerically \(3600 LE / \lambda\). notation \(3600 LE / (\lambda \rho_w)\) attributed METRIC secondary sources gives m h-1, mm h-1, \(\lambda\) J kg-1; factor 1000 mm m-1 written explicitly . primary reference resolves factor pending verification. Unit guard: lambda given MJ kg-1 (2.45) instead J kg-1 silently give evapotranspiration 1e6 times large. Values lambda outside [1e6, 1e7] J kg-1 therefore raise error class earthflux_domain_error. interval control units, physical range. negative le gives negative evapotranspiration (condensation energy balance \(H > R_n - G\)); returned unchanged without warning, never set zero. diagnostic flag EF_ET_NEGATIVE assembled orchestration layer. Missing values (NA, NaN) input propagate corresponding output element, without errors warnings. Arguments must numeric (double integer) length 1 common length; length-1 arguments recycled, arrays dim . Infinite values raise error class earthflux_domain_error (also earthflux_input_error). Verification status: VERIFICADA unit conversion (FAO-56, chapter 3, box 8 Eq. 20, plus 3600 s h-1); checked FAO-56 equivalences 1 mm d-1 = 2.45 MJ m-2 d-1 (chapter 1, table 1) 1 W m-2 = 0.035 mm d-1 (chapter 3, table 3). notation Allen et al. (2007) CANDIDATA (corroborated secondary sources).

title: Soil heat flux — ef_g
text: Bastiaanssen (SEBAL). $$\frac{G}{R_n} = T_c \, (0.0038 + 0.0074\,\alpha)\,   (1 - 0.98\,\mathrm{NDVI}^4), \qquad G = R_n \frac{G}{R_n}$$ \(T_c = T_s - 273.15\) degrees Celsius. ratio negative \(T_s < 273.15\) K NDVI enters even power, negative NDVI (water) gives result opposite positive NDVI. Tasumi (METRIC). $$\frac{G}{R_n} = 0.05 + 0.18\, e^{-0.521\,\mathrm{LAI}}, \qquad   G = R_n \frac{G}{R_n} \qquad (\mathrm{LAI} \ge 0.5)$$ $$G = 1.80\, T_c + 0.084\, R_n \qquad (\mathrm{LAI} < 0.5)$$ bare-soil branch evaluated directly, without dividing \(R_n\). relation discontinuous LAI = 0.5, belongs vegetated branch. Missing lst gives missing \(G\) branches (decision G-D5, provisional), result depend branch position falls . Assumptions: \(G\) \(R_n\) instantaneous overpass; \(G > 0\) heat flows surface ground. relations empirical, developed land surfaces near midday; rule applied water, snow impervious surfaces, must masked treated separately user. Inputs. Arguments must numeric length 1 common length; length-1 arguments recycled; matrix array arguments must share dim recycled. Missing values (NA, NaN) propagate corresponding output element without errors warnings.
